questions.stem: A surgeon attended a wedding party and had a few drinks. After the marriage party he performed a surgery. His colleagues noticed that his hands were visibly shaking while he was operating, couldn’t maintain balance while standing and he was slurring while speaking. During surgery, a major blood vessel was ruptured leading to death. Which of these would be applicable for the surgeon?
